<!doctype html>
<html lang="ja">
<head>
  <meta charset="utf-8" />
  <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width,initial-scale=1,viewport-fit=cover" />
  <meta name="theme-color" content="#080b12" />
  <link rel="manifest" href="./manifest.json" />
  <meta name="description" content="ギャンブル衝動を止め、Uber稼働・貯金・支払い・生活成長を一体管理する生活防衛PWA" />
  <link rel="icon" href="data:image/png;base64," />
  <link rel="apple-touch-icon" href="data:image/png;base64," />
  <style>
:root{
  color-scheme:dark;
  --bg:#060911;--panel:#0d121d;--panel2:#111827;--line:#202a3d;--line2:#2b3851;
  --text:#f5f7ff;--muted:#93a0ba;--cyan:#4de0ff;--violet:#8b5cf6;--danger:#ff4d6d;
  --ok:#4ade80;--warn:#ffb84d;--shadow:0 20px 60px rgba(0,0,0,.3)
}
*{box-sizing:border-box}
html{scroll-behavior:smooth;background:var(--bg)}
html,body{margin:0;min-height:100%;overflow-x:hidden;background:
radial-gradient(circle at 12% -7%,rgba(77,224,255,.1),transparent 26%),
radial-gradient(circle at 100% 0%,rgba(139,92,246,.09),transparent 30%),var(--bg);color:var(--text);
font-family:Inter,"Noto Sans JP",system-ui,-apple-system,BlinkMacSystemFont,"Segoe UI",sans-serif}
body{padding:env(safe-area-inset-top) env(safe-area-inset-right) calc(env(safe-area-inset-bottom) + 18px) env(safe-area-inset-left)}
button,input{font:inherit} button{touch-action:manipulation}
button:focus-visible,input:focus-visible,summary:focus-visible,a:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--cyan);outline-offset:2px}
a{color:inherit;text-decoration:none}
.hidden{display:none!important}
.app-shell{max-width:860px;margin:0 auto;padding:14px}
.topbar{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:12px;padding:6px 2px 12px}
.brand-lockup{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px}.brand-mark{width:34px;height:34px;border-radius:12px;display:grid;place-items:center;font-weight:1000;font-size:1.05rem;background:linear-gradient(135deg,#22d3ee,#6d5dfc 58%,#a855f7);box-shadow:0 0 25px rgba(77,224,255,.14);transform:skewX(-8deg)}
.topbar h1{margin:1px 0 0;font-size:1.22rem;letter-spacing:.06em}.topbar h1 span{color:var(--cyan)}
.eyebrow{font-size:.61rem;letter-spacing:.19em;color:var(--cyan);font-weight:900}
.card{background:linear-gradient(145deg,rgba(16,22,35,.97),rgba(8,12,20,.98));border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:20px;box-shadow:var(--shadow)}

/* HERO */
.visual-hero{position:relative;overflow:hidden;min-height:930px;background:#090d16;border-color:#27334a}
.hero-bg{position:absolute;inset:0;width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:cover;object-position:center;filter:saturate(.92) contrast(1.03);transition:opacity .25s}
.hero-bg-shade{position:absolute;inset:0;background:linear-gradient(180deg,rgba(4,8,16,.18) 0%,rgba(4,8,16,.06) 25%,rgba(5,8,14,.1) 49%,rgba(5,8,14,.82) 67%,rgba(5,8,14,.98) 100%)}
.hero-glow{position:absolute;inset:-20%;background:radial-gradient(circle at 50% 38%,rgba(77,224,255,.08),transparent 34%),radial-gradient(circle at 67% 22%,rgba(139,92,246,.12),transparent 27%);pointer-events:none}
.hero-statusbar{position:absolute;z-index:4;top:14px;left:14px;right:14px;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:10px}
.hero-topline{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;min-width:0;padding:8px 10px;border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.12);background:rgba(5,9,16,.62);backdrop-filter:blur(12px);border-radius:999px;font-size:.72rem;font-weight:900;letter-spacing:.03em;white-space:nowrap;overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis}
.status-dot{width:8px;height:8px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--ok);box-shadow:0 0 15px var(--ok);flex:0 0 auto}.status-dot.warn{background:var(--warn);box-shadow:0 0 15px var(--warn)}.status-dot.done{background:var(--cyan);box-shadow:0 0 15px var(--cyan)}
.hero-day-chip{padding:8px 10px;border-radius:999px;background:rgba(5,9,16,.62);border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.12);backdrop-filter:blur(12px);font-size:.58rem;color:var(--muted);letter-spacing:.09em;white-space:nowrap}.hero-day-chip span{color:white;font-size:.74rem;font-weight:950;margin-right:4px}
.character-stage{position:absolute;z-index:2;top:42px;left:0;right:0;height:390px;display:flex;align-items:flex-end;justify-content:center;pointer-events:none}
.hero-character{position:relative;z-index:2;display:block;height:365px;max-width:92%;object-fit:contain;filter:drop-shadow(0 22px 24px rgba(0,0,0,.42));transition:opacity .2s,transform .25s}.character-shadow{position:absolute;bottom:0;width:54%;height:28px;border-radius:50%;background:radial-gradient(ellipse,rgba(0,0,0,.6),transparent 70%);filter:blur(6px)}
.hero-growth-panel{position:absolute;z-index:5;top:365px;left:14px;right:14px;padding:11px 12px;border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.14);background:linear-gradient(135deg,rgba(6,10,18,.76),rgba(16,13,31,.7));backdrop-filter:blur(14px);border-radius:15px}
.hero-level-line{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px}.level-badge{display:grid;place-items:center;min-width:55px;height:44px;padding:0 8px;border:1px solid rgba(77,224,255,.38);border-radius:12px;background:linear-gradient(145deg,rgba(77,224,255,.13),rgba(139,92,246,.16));font-weight:1000;color:#dffbff;box-shadow:inset 0 0 18px rgba(77,224,255,.05)}
.hero-level-copy{display:flex;flex-direction:column;min-width:0}.hero-level-copy strong{font-size:.95rem;letter-spacing:.08em}.hero-level-copy span{font-size:.72rem;color:#cfd8ea;margin-top:2px}
.hero-xp-row{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;gap:10px;margin-top:9px;color:var(--muted);font-size:.65rem}.hero-xp-track{height:6px;border-radius:999px;background:rgba(255,255,255,.1);overflow:hidden;margin-top:5px}.hero-xp-track div{height:100%;width:0;background:linear-gradient(90deg,#50e4ff,#7c72ff,#b45fff);border-radius:inherit;transition:width .3s}.hero-next-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:6px;margin-top:8px}.hero-next-box{min-width:0;padding:7px 8px;border:1px solid rgba(77,224,255,.18);border-radius:10px;background:rgba(77,224,255,.035)}.hero-next-box.evolution{border-color:rgba(139,92,246,.25);background:rgba(139,92,246,.055)}.hero-next-box>span{display:block;color:#8edff1;font-size:.49rem;font-weight:950;letter-spacing:.12em}.hero-next-box.evolution>span{color:#b9a7ff}.hero-next-box strong{display:block;margin-top:2px;font-size:.7rem;white-space:nowrap;overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis}.hero-next-box small{display:block;margin-top:2px;color:var(--muted);font-size:.55rem;line-height:1.3}.hero-growth-motivation{margin-top:6px;padding:6px 8px;border-radius:9px;border:1px solid rgba(74,222,128,.18);background:rgba(74,222,128,.045);color:#b7efc8;font-size:.59rem;line-height:1.35;font-weight:750}
.hero-sheet{position:absolute;z-index:6;left:0;right:0;bottom:0;padding:19px 16px 16px;background:linear-gradient(180deg,rgba(8,12,21,.5),rgba(8,12,21,.98) 17%,#080c15 100%);border-top:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.08)}
.protected-row{display:flex;align-items:flex-end;justify-content:space-between;gap:12px}.sheet-label{display:block;color:#b8c4d9;font-size:.67rem}.protected-row>div:first-child strong{display:block;font-size:2rem;line-height:1.05;letter-spacing:-.045em;margin-top:2px}.mini-days{text-align:right}.mini-days span{display:block;color:var(--muted);font-size:.61rem}.mini-days strong{font-size:.95rem}
.shield-caption{color:var(--muted);font-size:.69rem;margin-top:5px}.value-alternatives{margin-top:9px;padding:9px;border:1px solid rgba(255,184,77,.18);border-radius:12px;background:linear-gradient(135deg,rgba(255,184,77,.04),rgba(77,224,255,.025))}.value-alternatives-head{display:flex;align-items:baseline;justify-content:space-between;gap:10px}.value-alternatives-head span{font-size:.61rem;color:#ffd59d;font-weight:900}.value-alternatives-head strong{font-size:.75rem;color:#fff1d7}.value-alternatives-list{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr);gap:5px;margin-top:7px}.value-alt{min-width:0;padding:7px;border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.075);border-radius:9px;background:rgba(5,9,16,.38)}.value-alt .icon{font-size:.85rem}.value-alt b{display:block;margin-top:2px;font-size:.62rem;line-height:1.25}.value-alt strong{display:block;margin-top:2px;font-size:.7rem;color:#fff}.value-alt small{display:block;margin-top:2px;color:var(--muted);font-size:.49rem;line-height:1.25}.value-alternatives-foot{margin-top:5px;color:#77859d;font-size:.48rem;line-height:1.3}.emergency-opportunity{margin-top:10px;padding:10px;border:1px solid rgba(255,184,77,.2);border-radius:12px;background:rgba(255,184,77,.045)}.emergency-opportunity>strong{display:block;color:#ffd29a;font-size:.76rem}.emergency-opportunity .value-alternatives-list{margin-top:7px}.today-command{margin:11px 0 9px;padding:9px 10px;border-radius:11px;border:1px solid rgba(77,224,255,.25);background:rgba(77,224,255,.055);color:#dbfaff;font-size:.72rem;font-weight:900;line-height:1.4}.today-command.danger-command{border-color:rgba(255,77,109,.36);background:rgba(255,77,109,.08);color:#ffc1cc}.today-command.done-command{border-color:rgba(74,222,128,.3);background:rgba(74,222,128,.065);color:#b6f4c8}
.hero-actions{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1.05fr 1fr;gap:8px}.hero-hint{margin:7px 0 0}
.hero-dashboard{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(4,1fr);gap:6px;margin-top:11px}.hero-dashboard a{min-width:0;padding:8px 7px;border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.08);border-radius:11px;background:rgba(255,255,255,.025)}.hero-dashboard span{display:block;color:var(--muted);font-size:.57rem}.hero-dashboard strong{display:block;margin-top:3px;font-size:.74rem;overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis;white-space:nowrap}
.loss-details{margin-top:9px;border-top:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.07);padding-top:7px}.loss-details summary{list-style:none;color:#9ba8bf;font-size:.65rem;cursor:pointer}.loss-details summary::-webkit-details-marker{display:none}.loss-details summary:after{content:"＋";float:right}.loss-details[open] summary:after{content:"−"}.split-metrics{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr);gap:6px;margin-top:8px}.split-metrics div{padding:8px;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:10px;background:rgba(255,255,255,.018)}.split-metrics span,.payment-summary span{display:block;color:var(--muted);font-size:.61rem}.split-metrics strong{display:block;margin-top:3px;font-size:.78rem}.split-metrics strong.needs-setting{color:#ffc56e;font-size:.72rem}
.visual-hero.recovery{border-color:rgba(255,184,77,.38)}.visual-hero.recovery .hero-bg-shade{background:linear-gradient(180deg,rgba(67,25,9,.18),rgba(7,8,13,.17) 48%,rgba(10,8,10,.96) 74%)}

/* controls */
.danger-btn,.primary-btn,.secondary-btn,.ghost-btn,.counter-btn,.small-btn,.text-btn{border:0;border-radius:12px;color:white;font-weight:850;cursor:pointer;transition:.15s transform,.15s opacity,.15s border-color;min-height:44px}.danger-btn,.primary-btn,.secondary-btn,.ghost-btn,.counter-btn{padding:11px 13px}.danger-btn{background:linear-gradient(135deg,#b31942,var(--danger));box-shadow:0 10px 26px rgba(255,77,109,.16)}.primary-btn{background:linear-gradient(135deg,#148eb0,#6d4ee8);box-shadow:0 10px 26px rgba(77,224,255,.08)}.secondary-btn{background:#151c2a;border:1px solid #2a3650}.ghost-btn{background:rgba(255,255,255,.015);border:1px solid var(--line2)}.counter-btn{background:#151b28;border:1px solid var(--line2);padding:10px}.counter-btn.accent{border-color:#3a5aab;background:linear-gradient(135deg,#102635,#241a4b)}.small-btn{background:#1b2940;padding:9px 13px}.text-btn{background:none;color:var(--cyan);padding:0;min-height:auto}.compact-btn{min-height:44px;padding:9px 11px;font-size:.75rem}.warn{color:#ffbe6b;border-color:#5a4126}button:disabled{opacity:.38;cursor:not-allowed}button:active:not(:disabled){transform:translateY(1px) scale(.99)}
.backup-notice{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:12px;border:1px solid rgba(255,184,77,.28);background:rgba(255,184,77,.07);border-radius:13px;padding:10px 12px;margin-bottom:12px;color:#ffd59d;font-size:.78rem}

/* common cards */
.single-card,.payment-card,.details-card{margin-top:12px}.progress-card,.payment-card,.savings-card,.growth-card{padding:16px}.section-title-row{display:flex;align-items:flex-start;justify-content:space-between;gap:13px}.section-title-row h2{font-size:1.03rem;margin:2px 0 0}.muted{color:var(--muted);font-size:.73rem}.compact{margin:4px 0 0}.wrap-gap{flex-wrap:wrap}
.uber-layout{display:grid;grid-template-columns:150px 1fr;align-items:center;gap:13px}.delivery-ring-wrap{display:flex;justify-content:center;margin:13px 0}.delivery-ring{--pct:0deg;width:130px;height:130px;border-radius:50%;display:grid;place-items:center;background:conic-gradient(var(--cyan) var(--pct),#1b2435 0);position:relative}.delivery-ring:after{content:"";position:absolute;inset:9px;border-radius:50%;background:#0b111b}.delivery-ring-inner{position:relative;z-index:1;display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center}.delivery-ring-inner strong{font-size:2.35rem}.delivery-ring-inner span{color:var(--muted);font-size:.73rem}.quick-actions{display:grid;grid-template-columns:.55fr 1.35fr 1fr;gap:7px}.field-label{display:block;margin-top:11px;color:var(--muted);font-size:.69rem}.money-input-row{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;margin-top:5px}.money-input-row>span{font-weight:900}.money-input-row input,.modal input,.modal select{width:100%;background:#080d15;border:1px solid #29344c;color:white;border-radius:10px;padding:10px;outline:none;min-height:44px}.progress-line,.payment-progress{height:7px;border-radius:999px;background:#171f2f;overflow:hidden;margin-top:12px}.progress-line>div,.payment-progress>div{height:100%;width:0;background:linear-gradient(90deg,var(--cyan),var(--violet));transition:width .25s}.progress-line.tall{height:9px}.microcopy{color:var(--muted);font-size:.71rem;line-height:1.5;margin-top:8px}.monthly-line{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;border-top:1px solid var(--line);margin-top:11px;padding-top:10px;font-size:.73rem;color:var(--muted)}.monthly-line strong{color:var(--text);font-size:.94rem}

/* payments */
.payment-summary{display:flex;gap:15px}.payment-summary strong{display:block;margin-top:3px;font-size:.9rem}.payment-list{display:grid;gap:7px;margin-top:11px}.payment-item{display:grid;grid-template-columns:auto 1.4fr .85fr auto;gap:8px;align-items:center;padding:10px;border:1px solid var(--line);background:#0a1019;border-radius:12px}.payment-item.paid{opacity:.58}.payment-item.overdue{border-color:rgba(255,77,109,.38)}.payment-item.urgent:not(.paid){border-color:rgba(255,184,77,.35)}.payment-check{width:21px;height:21px;accent-color:#57d982}.payment-name{font-weight:850}.payment-meta{color:var(--muted);font-size:.69rem;margin-top:2px}.payment-meta .due-over{color:#ff8298}.payment-meta .due-urgent{color:#ffc56e}.payment-amount{text-align:right;font-weight:900}.payment-edit{background:none;border:0;color:#95a4c4;cursor:pointer;font-size:1.02rem;min-width:44px;min-height:44px}.payment-actions{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:8px;margin-top:11px}.next-payment{margin-top:9px;padding:9px 10px;border-radius:10px;background:rgba(77,224,255,.055);border:1px solid rgba(77,224,255,.16);font-size:.73rem;color:#b9eefa}.next-payment.alert{background:rgba(255,184,77,.07);border-color:rgba(255,184,77,.25);color:#ffd59d}.next-payment.overdue{background:rgba(255,77,109,.07);border-color:rgba(255,77,109,.25);color:#ffb1bf}.paid-group{margin-top:2px;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:12px;overflow:hidden}.paid-group>summary{list-style:none;display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;gap:12px;padding:11px;color:var(--muted);font-size:.72rem;cursor:pointer;background:rgba(255,255,255,.015)}.paid-group>summary::-webkit-details-marker{display:none}.paid-group>summary:after{content:"表示";font-size:.65rem;color:#9aa7c0}.paid-group[open]>summary:after{content:"閉じる"}.paid-group-list{display:grid;gap:7px;padding:7px}.paid-group .payment-item{border-color:#1c2432;background:#090e16}.all-paid-banner{padding:10px 11px;border:1px solid rgba(74,222,128,.25);background:rgba(74,222,128,.06);border-radius:11px;color:#a7efbd;font-size:.75rem}.arrears-box{margin-top:10px}.arrears-group{border:1px solid rgba(255,77,109,.35);background:rgba(255,77,109,.05);border-radius:12px;overflow:hidden}.arrears-group>summary{list-style:none;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:12px;padding:10px 11px;cursor:pointer;color:#ffd0d8}.arrears-group>summary::-webkit-details-marker{display:none}.arrears-group>summary span{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:2px}.arrears-group>summary small{color:#d99aaa;font-size:.63rem;font-weight:500}.arrears-group>summary:after{content:"−";color:#d99aaa}.arrears-group:not([open])>summary:after{content:"＋"}.arrears-list{display:grid;gap:7px;padding:7px;border-top:1px solid rgba(255,77,109,.16)}.arrears-list .payment-item{background:#100d14;border-color:rgba(255,77,109,.22)}.payment-growth{display:block;margin-top:3px;font-size:.65rem}.payment-growth.better{color:#78e49a}.payment-growth.same{color:#9fb0cc}.payment-growth.later{color:#f0bd77}

/* savings + growth */
.big-money{font-size:2.65rem;font-weight:1000;letter-spacing:-.05em;margin-top:17px}.milestone-row{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;gap:10px;color:var(--muted);font-size:.73rem;margin-top:9px}.growth-level{display:flex;align-items:baseline;gap:3px;color:var(--muted);font-size:.62rem;letter-spacing:.07em}.growth-level strong{font-size:1.42rem;color:var(--cyan)}.growth-detail-head{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:14px;margin-top:10px;padding:10px;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:15px;background:linear-gradient(135deg,rgba(77,224,255,.035),rgba(139,92,246,.04))}.growth-mini-character{width:86px;height:105px;object-fit:contain;filter:drop-shadow(0 10px 13px rgba(0,0,0,.35));flex:0 0 auto}.growth-copy{min-width:0}.growth-stage{font-size:.65rem;letter-spacing:.16em;color:var(--cyan);font-weight:950}.growth-title{font-size:1.2rem;font-weight:1000;margin-top:3px;letter-spacing:-.02em}.growth-metrics{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(4,1fr);gap:6px;margin-top:11px}.growth-metrics div{border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:10px;background:rgba(255,255,255,.018);padding:8px}.growth-metrics span{display:block;color:var(--muted);font-size:.57rem;line-height:1.25}.growth-metrics strong{display:block;margin-top:3px;font-size:.82rem}.growth-note{margin-top:9px;border:1px solid rgba(74,222,128,.17);background:rgba(74,222,128,.045);border-radius:10px;padding:8px 9px;color:#a9dcb8;font-size:.69rem;line-height:1.45}.growth-progress>div{background:linear-gradient(90deg,#4ade80,var(--cyan),var(--violet))}.evolution-heading{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;gap:12px;align-items:baseline;margin-top:15px}.evolution-heading span{font-size:.78rem;font-weight:900}.evolution-heading small{color:var(--muted);font-size:.58rem}.growth-track{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(6,1fr);gap:6px;margin-top:8px}.growth-node{padding:7px 3px;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:9px;text-align:center;background:#0a1019;opacity:.42;position:relative}.growth-node.unlocked{opacity:.85;border-color:#31425f}.growth-node.current{opacity:1;border-color:rgba(77,224,255,.48);background:linear-gradient(145deg,rgba(77,224,255,.08),rgba(139,92,246,.1));box-shadow:0 0 22px rgba(77,224,255,.05)}.growth-node .n{font-size:.64rem;font-weight:1000}.growth-node .s{display:block;margin-top:2px;font-size:.48rem;color:var(--muted);overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis;white-space:nowrap}.growth-node.current .n{color:var(--cyan)}

/* details */
.details-card{overflow:hidden}.details-card summary{list-style:none;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:13px;padding:15px 16px;cursor:pointer;min-height:68px}.details-card summary::-webkit-details-marker{display:none}.details-card summary:after{content:"＋";color:var(--muted);font-size:1.05rem}.details-card[open] summary:after{content:"−"}.details-card[open] summary{border-bottom:1px solid var(--line)}.details-body{padding:14px 16px 16px}.summary-stats{display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:flex-end;gap:2px;color:var(--muted);font-size:.71rem;margin-left:auto}.calendar-legend{display:flex;gap:13px;color:var(--muted);font-size:.68rem;margin-bottom:10px}.calendar-legend span{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:5px}.legend{width:8px;height:8px;border-radius:3px;background:#151c29}.legend.clean{background:rgba(74,222,128,.75)}.legend.lapse{background:rgba(255,77,109,.75)}.calendar90{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(15,1fr);gap:4px}.day-cell{aspect-ratio:1;border-radius:5px;background:#151c29;border:1px solid #202a3b;display:grid;place-items:center;font-size:.53rem;color:#66738d}.day-cell.clean{background:rgba(74,222,128,.12);border-color:rgba(74,222,128,.4);color:#8ff0ae}.day-cell.lapse{background:rgba(255,77,109,.12);border-color:rgba(255,77,109,.4);color:#ff8298}.day-cell.pledged:not(.clean):not(.lapse){border-color:rgba(77,224,255,.34);color:#9bdff0}.day-cell.today{outline:1px solid var(--cyan);box-shadow:0 0 0 2px rgba(77,224,255,.08)}.control-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(2,1fr);gap:8px}.file-label{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;text-align:center;cursor:pointer}

/* modals */
.modal-backdrop{position:fixed;inset:0;background:rgba(0,0,0,.8);backdrop-filter:blur(7px);display:grid;place-items:center;padding:14px;z-index:100}.modal{width:min(610px,100%);max-height:92vh;overflow:auto;background:#090f18;border:1px solid #2a344c;border-radius:20px;box-shadow:0 28px 90px #000;padding:17px}.modal h3{margin:4px 0 8px}.modal .form-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:10px}.modal label{display:block;color:var(--muted);font-size:.75rem;margin-top:8px}.modal-actions{display:flex;gap:8px;justify-content:flex-end;margin-top:14px;flex-wrap:wrap}.modal-actions .grow{margin-right:auto}.mini-note{font-size:.69rem;color:var(--muted);line-height:1.5}.safe-banner{padding:10px;border:1px solid rgba(74,222,128,.3);background:rgba(74,222,128,.07);border-radius:10px;margin-top:11px;font-size:.77rem}.danger-copy{color:#ffb7c3}.lock-note{color:#ffc56e}
.emergency-modal{border-color:#5d2636;background:radial-gradient(circle at 100% 0%,rgba(255,77,109,.12),transparent 30%),#090f18}.emergency-visual{display:grid;grid-template-columns:155px 1fr;gap:12px;align-items:center;padding:8px;border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.08);border-radius:15px;background:rgba(255,255,255,.02)}.emergency-character{width:155px;height:190px;object-fit:contain;filter:drop-shadow(0 12px 18px rgba(0,0,0,.45))}.timer{font-size:3.9rem;font-weight:1000;letter-spacing:-.06em;line-height:1}.loss-preview{font-size:1rem;font-weight:900;color:#ffc0cb;margin-top:7px}.emergency-steps{display:grid;gap:6px;margin-top:12px}.emergency-step{padding:10px;border:1px solid #2c3548;border-radius:10px;background:#0d131e}.emergency-step strong{display:block}.emergency-step span{color:var(--muted);font-size:.73rem}.emergency-checks{display:grid;gap:6px;margin-top:10px}.emergency-checks label{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;margin:0;padding:9px 10px;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:10px;background:#0c111a;color:var(--text);font-size:.76rem}.emergency-checks input{width:20px;height:20px;min-height:auto;accent-color:var(--ok)}
.recovery-modal{border-color:rgba(255,184,77,.35);background:radial-gradient(circle at 95% 0%,rgba(255,184,77,.09),transparent 32%),#090f18}.recovery-visual{display:grid;grid-template-columns:150px 1fr;gap:12px;align-items:center}.recovery-visual img{width:150px;height:190px;object-fit:contain}.recovery-loss{font-size:1.75rem;font-weight:1000;color:#ffd29a;margin-top:3px}.recovery-rule{display:grid;gap:6px;margin-top:11px}.recovery-rule div{padding:9px 10px;border-radius:10px;border:1px solid var(--line);background:#0d131e;font-size:.75rem}.recovery-rule strong{color:#fff}

/* achievement */
.achievement-toast{position:fixed;z-index:140;left:50%;top:max(14px,env(safe-area-inset-top));transform:translateX(-50%);width:min(380px,calc(100vw - 28px));display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;padding:10px 12px;border:1px solid rgba(77,224,255,.36);border-radius:15px;background:linear-gradient(135deg,rgba(8,18,29,.97),rgba(26,15,48,.97));box-shadow:0 20px 55px rgba(0,0,0,.5)}.achievement-toast img{width:58px;height:68px;object-fit:contain}.achievement-toast .a-copy{min-width:0}.achievement-toast .a-kicker{font-size:.57rem;letter-spacing:.14em;color:var(--cyan);font-weight:950}.achievement-toast strong{display:block;margin-top:2px}.achievement-toast span{display:block;margin-top:2px;color:var(--muted);font-size:.66rem}

@media(max-width:620px){
 .app-shell{padding:11px}.visual-hero{min-height:960px}.character-stage{height:395px}.hero-character{height:370px}.hero-growth-panel{top:372px}.hero-actions{grid-template-columns:1fr}.uber-layout{grid-template-columns:1fr}.uber-controls{margin-top:-4px}.payment-summary{width:100%;justify-content:space-between}.calendar90{grid-template-columns:repeat(10,1fr)}.growth-track{grid-template-columns:repeat(4,1fr)}
}
@media(max-width:430px){
 .topbar{align-items:flex-start}.brand-mark{width:31px;height:31px}.topbar h1{font-size:1.08rem}.visual-hero{min-height:985px;border-radius:18px}.hero-statusbar{top:10px;left:10px;right:10px}.hero-topline{font-size:.65rem;padding:7px 8px;max-width:72%}.hero-day-chip{padding:7px 8px}.character-stage{top:38px;height:372px}.hero-character{height:352px;max-width:96%}.hero-growth-panel{top:350px;left:10px;right:10px}.hero-sheet{padding:19px 12px 13px}.protected-row>div:first-child strong{font-size:1.85rem}.hero-dashboard{gap:5px}.hero-dashboard a{padding:7px 5px}.hero-dashboard strong{font-size:.69rem}.split-metrics{gap:5px}.split-metrics div{padding:7px 5px}.progress-card,.payment-card,.savings-card,.growth-card{padding:14px}.payment-item{grid-template-columns:auto 1fr auto}.payment-item .payment-amount{grid-column:3;grid-row:1}.payment-item .payment-edit{grid-column:3;grid-row:2}.quick-actions{grid-template-columns:.55fr 1.35fr 1fr}.growth-metrics{grid-template-columns:repeat(2,1fr)}.growth-track{grid-template-columns:repeat(4,1fr);gap:5px}.evolution-heading{align-items:flex-start}.evolution-heading small{max-width:46%;text-align:right}.control-grid{grid-template-columns:1fr}.modal .form-grid{grid-template-columns:1fr}.emergency-visual,.recovery-visual{grid-template-columns:115px 1fr}.emergency-character,.recovery-visual img{width:115px;height:150px}.timer{font-size:3.25rem}.calendar90{grid-template-columns:repeat(10,1fr)}
}

/* v0.5 motion + asset safety */
.hero-bg.asset-failed{opacity:0}
.hero-character.asset-failed,.growth-mini-character.asset-failed,.emergency-character.asset-failed,.recovery-visual img.asset-failed{opacity:0}
.achievement-toast{opacity:0;transform:translate(-50%,-14px);transition:opacity .22s ease,transform .22s ease;pointer-events:none}
.achievement-toast.show{opacity:1;transform:translate(-50%,0)}
.visual-hero.evolving .hero-character{animation:nb90-evolve 1.05s cubic-bezier(.2,.8,.2,1)}
.visual-hero.evolving .hero-growth-panel{animation:nb90-panel-pulse .9s ease}
@keyframes nb90-evolve{0%{transform:scale(.92);filter:drop-shadow(0 22px 24px rgba(0,0,0,.42)) brightness(.9)}45%{transform:scale(1.035);filter:drop-shadow(0 0 32px rgba(77,224,255,.62)) brightness(1.18)}100%{transform:scale(1);filter:drop-shadow(0 22px 24px rgba(0,0,0,.42)) brightness(1)}}
@keyframes nb90-panel-pulse{0%,100%{box-shadow:none}45%{box-shadow:0 0 30px rgba(77,224,255,.16)}}
@media (prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.visual-hero.evolving .hero-character,.visual-hero.evolving .hero-growth-panel{animation:none}.achievement-toast{transition:none}}

/* v0.7 exact payment deadlines */
.payment-item{grid-template-columns:auto minmax(0,1.4fr) minmax(72px,.85fr) auto}
.payment-row-actions{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:2px}
.payment-delete{background:none;border:0;color:#d98296;cursor:pointer;font-size:.9rem;min-width:40px;min-height:40px;border-radius:9px}
.payment-delete:hover,.payment-delete:focus-visible{background:rgba(255,77,109,.08)}
.payment-type{display:inline-flex!important;align-items:center;margin-right:6px;padding:1px 5px;border-radius:999px;border:1px solid rgba(120,143,182,.22);color:#9fb0cc;font-size:.58rem!important;line-height:1.4}
.payment-item.missing-due{border-color:rgba(255,184,77,.3)}
.payment-meta .due-missing{color:#ffc56e}
.deadline-notice{margin-top:9px;padding:9px 10px;border-radius:10px;background:rgba(255,184,77,.07);border:1px solid rgba(255,184,77,.25);font-size:.72rem;line-height:1.45;color:#ffd59d}
.deadline-notice.hidden{display:none}
.check-label{display:flex!important;align-items:center;gap:8px}.check-label input{width:19px!important;min-height:19px!important;accent-color:#57d982}
.modal select{appearance:auto}
@media(max-width:390px){.payment-item{grid-template-columns:auto minmax(0,1fr) auto}.payment-item .payment-amount{grid-column:3;grid-row:1}.payment-row-actions{grid-column:3;grid-row:2;justify-content:flex-end}.payment-edit,.payment-delete{min-width:38px;min-height:38px}}

/* v0.8 motivation + opportunity value */
@media(max-width:430px){.hero-next-grid{gap:5px}.hero-next-box{padding:6px 7px}.hero-next-box strong{font-size:.64rem}.hero-next-box small{font-size:.5rem}.value-alternatives-list{gap:4px}.value-alt{padding:6px 5px}.value-alt b{font-size:.57rem}.value-alt strong{font-size:.65rem}.value-alt small{font-size:.45rem}}
@media(max-width:360px){.value-alternatives-list{grid-template-columns:1fr}.value-alt{display:grid;grid-template-columns:24px 1fr auto;gap:5px;align-items:center}.value-alt .icon{grid-row:1/3}.value-alt b{margin:0}.value-alt strong{margin:0;text-align:right}.value-alt small{grid-column:2/4;margin:0}.visual-hero{min-height:1110px}}

</style>
  <title>NO BET 90</title>
</head>
<body>
  <div id="app" class="app-shell">
    <header class="topbar">
      <div class="brand-lockup">
        <div class="brand-mark" aria-hidden="true">N</div>
        <div>
          <div class="eyebrow">LIFE DEFENSE</div>
          <h1>NO BET <span>90</span></h1>
        </div>
      </div>
      <button id="installBtn" class="ghost-btn compact-btn hidden">アプリとして追加</button>
    </header>

    <aside id="backupNotice" class="backup-notice hidden" aria-live="polite">
      <span>データのバックアップ時期です。</span>
      <button id="backupNoticeBtn" class="text-btn">今すぐ保存</button>
    </aside>

    <main>
      <section id="heroCard" class="visual-hero card">
        <img id="growthBackground" class="hero-bg" alt="成長に応じて変化する生活背景" />
        <div class="hero-bg-shade"></div>
        <div class="hero-glow"></div>

        <div class="hero-statusbar">
          <div class="hero-topline"><span id="statusDot" class="status-dot"></span><span id="heroStateLabel">NO GAMBLING — DAY 1 / 90</span></div>
          <div class="hero-day-chip"><span id="streakDays">0日</span> STREAK</div>
        </div>

        <div class="character-stage">
          <img id="growthCharacter" class="hero-character" alt="成長アバター" />
          <div class="character-shadow"></div>
        </div>

        <div class="hero-growth-panel">
          <div class="hero-level-line">
            <span id="heroGrowthLevel" class="level-badge">Lv.1</span>
            <div class="hero-level-copy"><strong id="heroGrowthStage">RESTART I</strong><span id="heroGrowthTitle">再起動前</span></div>
          </div>
          <div class="hero-xp-row"><span id="heroGrowthXpLabel">0 GROWTH</span><span id="heroGrowthNextLabel">NEXT RESTART II</span></div>
          <div class="hero-xp-track"><div id="heroGrowthProgress"></div></div>
          <div class="hero-next-grid" aria-label="次の成長目標">
            <div class="hero-next-box">
              <span>NEXT TITLE</span>
              <strong id="heroNextTitleName">RESTART II</strong>
              <small id="heroNextTitleRemain">あと 27 GROWTH</small>
            </div>
            <div class="hero-next-box evolution">
              <span>NEXT EVOLUTION</span>
              <strong id="heroNextEvolutionName">Lv.2 SPARK</strong>
              <small id="heroNextEvolutionRemain">あと 80 GROWTH</small>
            </div>
          </div>
          <div id="heroGrowthMotivation" class="hero-growth-motivation">今日を守る +10 / Uber達成 +5</div>
        </div>

        <div class="hero-sheet">
          <div class="protected-row">
            <div><span class="sheet-label">今日守っている最低額</span><strong id="protectedAmount">¥33,000</strong></div>
            <div class="mini-days"><span>累計</span><strong id="cleanDays">0日</strong></div>
          </div>
          <div id="shieldCaption" class="shield-caption">今日ギャンブルをしないことで守る最低額</div>

          <div class="value-alternatives" id="valueAlternatives">
            <div class="value-alternatives-head"><span>この損失を防げば</span><strong id="valueAlternativesAmount">¥33,000</strong></div>
            <div id="valueAlternativesList" class="value-alternatives-list" aria-label="この金額でできることの例"></div>
            <div class="value-alternatives-foot">※金額を日常の選択肢に置き換えた換算例。毎日3例が変わります。</div>
          </div>

          <div id="todayCommand" class="today-command">最優先：防衛開始 → Uberを1件</div>

          <div class="hero-actions">
            <button id="urgeBtn" class="danger-btn">今、ギャンブルに行きたい</button>
            <button id="safeTodayBtn" class="primary-btn">今日の防衛を開始</button>
          </div>
          <p id="heroHint" class="microcopy hero-hint">最初に「今日の防衛を開始」。1日を終える時に同じボタンで完了します。</p>

          <div class="hero-dashboard" aria-label="今日の状態">
            <a href="#uberSection"><span>Uber</span><strong id="heroUber">0 / 20</strong></a>
            <a href="#paymentSection"><span>支払い</span><strong id="heroPayment">0 / 0</strong></a>
            <a href="#savingsSection"><span>貯金</span><strong id="heroSavings">¥0</strong></a>
            <a href="#growthSection"><span>禁ギャンブル</span><strong id="heroStreak">0日</strong></a>
          </div>

          <details class="loss-details">
            <summary>1回の損失影響を確認</summary>
            <div class="split-metrics">
              <div><span>直接損失</span><strong id="avoidGamble">¥20,000</strong></div>
              <div><span>当日稼働</span><strong id="avoidUber">¥13,000</strong></div>
              <div><span>後日の影響</span><strong id="avoidAfter">未設定</strong></div>
            </div>
          </details>
        </div>
      </section>

      <section id="uberSection" class="card progress-card single-card">
        <div class="section-title-row">
          <div><div class="eyebrow">TODAY MISSION</div><h2>Uber 稼働</h2></div>
          <span id="todayDate" class="muted"></span>
        </div>
        <div class="uber-layout">
          <div class="delivery-ring-wrap">
            <div id="deliveryRing" class="delivery-ring" aria-label="今日の配達進捗">
              <div class="delivery-ring-inner"><strong id="deliveryCount">0</strong><span id="deliveryTargetLabel">/ 20件</span></div>
            </div>
          </div>
          <div class="uber-controls">
            <div class="quick-actions">
              <button id="minusDelivery" class="counter-btn" aria-label="配達件数を1減らす">−1</button>
              <button id="plusDelivery" class="counter-btn accent">+1 配達</button>
              <button id="setDelivery" class="counter-btn">件数入力</button>
            </div>
            <label class="field-label" for="earningsInput">今日の売上</label>
            <div class="money-input-row"><span>¥</span><input id="earningsInput" inputmode="numeric" type="number" min="0" step="100" placeholder="0" /><button id="saveEarnings" class="small-btn">保存</button></div>
          </div>
        </div>
        <div class="progress-line"><div id="deliveryProgress"></div></div>
        <div id="todayStatus" class="microcopy">まず1件。1件終われば流れが変わる。</div>
        <div class="monthly-line"><span>今月のUber売上</span><strong id="monthlyUber">¥0</strong></div>
      </section>

      <section id="paymentSection" class="card payment-card">
        <div class="section-title-row wrap-gap">
          <div><div class="eyebrow">PAYMENT DEFENSE</div><h2>支払い管理</h2><p class="muted compact" id="paymentMonthLabel"></p></div>
          <div class="payment-summary">
            <div><span>合計</span><strong id="paymentTotal">¥0</strong></div>
            <div><span>支払済</span><strong id="paymentPaid">¥0</strong></div>
            <div><span>残り</span><strong id="paymentRemain">¥0</strong></div>
          </div>
        </div>
        <div class="payment-progress"><div id="paymentProgressBar"></div></div>
        <div id="arrearsBox" class="arrears-box hidden"></div>
        <div id="paymentDeadlineNotice" class="deadline-notice hidden"></div>
        <div id="nextPaymentAlert" class="next-payment hidden"></div>
        <div id="paymentList" class="payment-list"></div>
        <div class="payment-actions"><button id="addPaymentBtn" class="secondary-btn">＋ 支払い項目を追加</button><button id="copyPrevPaymentsBtn" class="ghost-btn">毎月項目を再同期</button></div>
        <div class="microcopy">毎月の支払いは最大12種類。本来の期限日を入れると、古い未払いも超過日数を正確に表示します。支払日は支払済みにした時に自動記録します。</div>
      </section>

      <section id="savingsSection" class="card savings-card single-card">
        <div class="section-title-row"><div><div class="eyebrow">REAL MONEY</div><h2>実貯金</h2></div><button id="editSavingsBtn" class="ghost-btn compact-btn">残高を変更</button></div>
        <div class="big-money" id="savingsBig">¥0</div>
        <div class="milestone-row"><span id="milestoneLabel">最初の目標 ¥10,000</span><span id="milestonePercent">0%</span></div>
        <div class="progress-line tall"><div id="savingsProgress"></div></div>
        <div id="milestoneMessage" class="microcopy">最初の1万円を作る。ここから流れを変える。</div>
      </section>

      <section id="growthSection" class="card growth-card single-card">
        <div class="section-title-row">
          <div><div class="eyebrow">LIFE GROWTH</div><h2>成長ログ</h2></div>
          <div class="growth-level"><span>LV.</span><strong id="growthLevel">1</strong></div>
        </div>
        <div class="growth-detail-head">
          <img id="growthMiniCharacter" class="growth-mini-character" alt="現在の成長アバター" />
          <div class="growth-copy">
            <div id="growthStage" class="growth-stage">RESTART I</div>
            <div id="growthTitle" class="growth-title">再起動前</div>
            <div id="growthMessage" class="microcopy">現実の改善だけで進化します。</div>
          </div>
        </div>
        <div class="milestone-row"><span id="growthXpLabel">0 GROWTH</span><span id="growthNextLabel">次まで 27</span></div>
        <div class="progress-line tall growth-progress"><div id="growthProgress"></div></div>
        <div class="growth-metrics">
          <div><span>禁ギャンブル</span><strong id="growthClean">0日</strong></div>
          <div><span>Uber達成</span><strong id="growthUber">0日</strong></div>
          <div><span>期限内支払い</span><strong id="growthPay">0件</strong></div>
          <div><span>衝動を越えた日</span><strong id="growthEmergency">0日</strong></div>
        </div>
        <div id="paymentGrowthNote" class="growth-note">支払い比較は、同じ項目を翌月も使うと表示されます。</div>
        <div class="evolution-heading"><span>12段階の進化</span><small>一度到達した段階は退化しません</small></div>
        <div id="growthTrack" class="growth-track" aria-label="進化段階"></div>
      </section>

      <details id="challengeDetails" class="card details-card">
        <summary><div><div class="eyebrow">90 DAYS</div><strong>防衛記録</strong></div><div class="summary-stats"><span id="challengeSummary">0 / 90日</span><span id="challengeStreakSummary">連続 0日</span></div></summary>
        <div class="details-body"><div class="calendar-legend"><span><i class="legend clean"></i>守った日</span><span><i class="legend lapse"></i>ギャンブルした日</span></div><div id="calendar90" class="calendar90"></div></div>
      </details>

      <details class="card details-card tools-card">
        <summary><div><div class="eyebrow">TOOLS</div><strong>設定・バックアップ</strong></div><span id="backupStatus" class="muted">端末内保存</span></summary>
        <div class="details-body">
          <div class="control-grid">
            <button id="settingsBtn" class="secondary-btn">損失・目標設定</button>
            <button id="exportBtn" class="secondary-btn">データを書き出す</button>
            <label class="secondary-btn file-label">データを読み込む<input id="importInput" type="file" accept="application/json" hidden /></label>
            <button id="recordLapseBtn" class="ghost-btn warn">ギャンブルしてしまった日を記録</button>
          </div>
          <p class="microcopy">記録は端末内に保存します。7日ごとのバックアップを推奨します。</p>
        </div>
      </details>
    </main>
  </div>

  <div id="achievementToast" class="achievement-toast hidden" aria-live="polite"></div>
  <div id="modalRoot"></div>
  <script>
const STORAGE_KEY='noBet90DataV5';
const LEGACY_STORAGE_KEYS=['noBet90DataV4','noBet90DataV3','noBet90DataV2','noBet90DataV1'];
const DATA_VERSION=8;
const EMERGENCY_MIN_LOCK_MS=5*60*1000;
const EMERGENCY_TOTAL_MS=15*60*1000;

const storage=(()=>{
  try{
    const k='__nb90_storage_test__';
    window.localStorage.setItem(k,'1');
    window.localStorage.removeItem(k);
    return window.localStorage;
  }catch{
    const mem=new Map();
    return {getItem:k=>mem.has(k)?mem.get(k):null,setItem:(k,v)=>mem.set(k,String(v)),removeItem:k=>mem.delete(k)};
  }
})();

const money=n=>new Intl.NumberFormat('ja-JP',{style:'currency',currency:'JPY',maximumFractionDigits:0}).format(Number(n)||0);
const ymd=(d=new Date())=>{const y=d.getFullYear(),m=String(d.getMonth()+1).padStart(2,'0'),day=String(d.getDate()).padStart(2,'0');return `${y}-${m}-${day}`};
const monthKey=(d=new Date())=>`${d.getFullYear()}-${String(d.getMonth()+1).padStart(2,'0')}`;
const operationalDate=(d=new Date(),resetHour=4)=>{const x=new Date(d);if(x.getHours()<clamp(Number(resetHour)||0,0,12))x.setDate(x.getDate()-1);return x};
const parseDate=s=>{const [y,m,d]=String(s).split('-').map(Number);return new Date(y,m-1,d)};
const dueDateStringForMonth=(k,dueDay)=>{const [y,m]=String(k).split('-').map(Number);if(!y||!m||!dueDay)return null;const last=new Date(y,m,0).getDate(),day=Math.min(clamp(Number(dueDay)||1,1,31),last);return `${y}-${String(m).padStart(2,'0')}-${String(day).padStart(2,'0')}`};
const daysBetween=(a,b)=>Math.floor((new Date(b.getFullYear(),b.getMonth(),b.getDate())-new Date(a.getFullYear(),a.getMonth(),a.getDate()))/86400000);
const clamp=(n,a,b)=>Math.max(a,Math.min(b,n));
const uid=()=>`${Date.now().toString(36)}-${Math.random().toString(36).slice(2,8)}`;
const escapeAttr=s=>String(s??'').replace(/&/g,'&amp;').replace(/"/g,'&quot;').replace(/</g,'&lt;').replace(/>/g,'&gt;');

const defaultData=()=>({
  version:DATA_VERSION,
  createdAt:ymd(operationalDate(new Date(),4)),
  updatedAt:new Date().toISOString(),
  settings:{dailyTarget:20,gambleLoss:20000,uberOpportunityLoss:13000,afterImpactDays:0,afterImpactPerDay:0,challengeDays:90,savingsGoal:100000,dayResetHour:4},
  days:{},
  savings:0,
  payments:{},
  paymentSeriesDisabled:{},
  lapses:[],
  urgeEvents:[],
  emergencyUntil:null,
  emergencyStartedAt:null,
  emergencyChecks:{away:false,uber:false,noChase:false},
  lastBackupAt:null,
  growthPeakXp:0
});

function normalizePayment(p={},index=0,key=''){
  const recurrence=p.recurrence==='once'?'once':'monthly';
  let dueDay=p.dueDay;
  if(dueDay===undefined||dueDay===null||dueDay===''){
    const match=String(p.due||'').match(/\d{1,2}/);
    dueDay=match?Number(match[0]):null;
  }
  if(dueDay!==null&&dueDay!=='')dueDay=clamp(Number(dueDay)||1,1,31);else dueDay=null;
  let dueDate=/^\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}$/.test(String(p.dueDate||''))?String(p.dueDate):null;
  // v0.6以前の「毎月○日」データは、そのレコードが属する月の実期限日に変換して保持する。
  if(!dueDate&&dueDay&&/^\d{4}-\d{2}$/.test(String(key)))dueDate=dueDateStringForMonth(key,dueDay);
  return {
    id:p.id||`${key}-${index}-${uid()}`,
    seriesId:recurrence==='monthly'?(p.seriesId||null):null,
    recurrence,
    name:String(p.name||'名称未設定'),
    amount:Math.max(0,Number(p.amount)||0),
    dueDay:recurrence==='monthly'?dueDay:null,
    // dueDate は「この1件が本来いつまでの支払いだったか」。毎月項目でも各発生分ごとに固定する。
    dueDate,
    paid:Boolean(p.paid),
    paidAt:p.paidAt||null
  };
}
function migrate(raw){
  const base=defaultData();
  const x=raw&&typeof raw==='object'?raw:{};
  const out={...base,...x,version:DATA_VERSION,settings:{...base.settings,...(x.settings||{})}};
  out.days={};
  for(const [k,v] of Object.entries(x.days||{})){
    const rec=v&&typeof v==='object'?v:{};
    out.days[k]={
      pledged:Boolean(rec.pledged||rec.clean),
      pledgedAt:rec.pledgedAt||null,
      clean:Boolean(rec.clean&&!rec.lapse),
      completedAt:rec.completedAt||null,
      lapse:Boolean(rec.lapse),
      recoverySecured:Boolean(rec.recoverySecured),
      deliveries:Math.max(0,Number(rec.deliveries)||0),
      earnings:Math.max(0,Number(rec.earnings)||0)
    };
  }
  out.payments={};
  const legacySeriesByName=new Map();
  for(const k of Object.keys(x.payments||{}).sort()){
    const list=x.payments?.[k];
    out.payments[k]=Array.isArray(list)?list.slice(0,12).map((p,i)=>normalizePayment(p,i,k)):[];
    for(const p of out.payments[k]){
      if(p.recurrence!=='monthly')continue;
      const nk=String(p.name||'').trim().toLocaleLowerCase('ja-JP');
      if(!p.seriesId)p.seriesId=legacySeriesByName.get(nk)||p.id||uid();
      if(nk&&!legacySeriesByName.has(nk))legacySeriesByName.set(nk,p.seriesId);
    }
  }
  out.paymentSeriesDisabled={...(x.paymentSeriesDisabled||{})};
  out.lapses=Array.isArray(x.lapses)?x.lapses.map(l=>({...l,loss:Math.max(0,Number(l.loss)||0)})):[];
  out.urgeEvents=Array.isArray(x.urgeEvents)?x.urgeEvents:[];
  out.savings=Math.max(0,Number(x.savings)||0);
  out.emergencyUntil=Number(x.emergencyUntil)||null;
  out.emergencyStartedAt=Number(x.emergencyStartedAt)||null;
  out.emergencyChecks={away:Boolean(x.emergencyChecks?.away),uber:Boolean(x.emergencyChecks?.uber),noChase:Boolean(x.emergencyChecks?.noChase)};
  out.settings.dayResetHour=clamp(Number(out.settings.dayResetHour??4),0,12);
  out.lastBackupAt=x.lastBackupAt||null;
  out.growthPeakXp=Math.max(0,Number(x.growthPeakXp)||0);
  return out;
}

function load(){
  try{
    const current=storage.getItem(STORAGE_KEY);
    if(current){
      const parsed=JSON.parse(current),migrated=migrate(parsed);
      if(Number(parsed?.version)!==DATA_VERSION)storage.setItem(STORAGE_KEY,JSON.stringify(migrated));
      return migrated;
    }
    for(const key of LEGACY_STORAGE_KEYS){
      const legacy=storage.getItem(key);
      if(legacy){const migrated=migrate(JSON.parse(legacy));storage.setItem(STORAGE_KEY,JSON.stringify(migrated));return migrated}
    }
  }catch{}
  return defaultData();
}

let data=load();
let modalLocked=false;
if(syncRecurringPaymentsThrough(currentMonthKey()))storage.setItem(STORAGE_KEY,JSON.stringify(data));
if(!storage.getItem(STORAGE_KEY))storage.setItem(STORAGE_KEY,JSON.stringify(data));

function save(render=true){
  data.version=DATA_VERSION;
  data.updatedAt=new Date().toISOString();
  storage.setItem(STORAGE_KEY,JSON.stringify(data));
  if(render)renderAll();
}
function appDate(){return operationalDate(new Date(),data?.settings?.dayResetHour??4)}
function appDayKey(){return ymd(appDate())}
function currentMonthKey(){return monthKey(appDate())}
function ensureToday(){
  const k=appDayKey();
  if(!data.days[k])data.days[k]={pledged:false,pledgedAt:null,clean:false,completedAt:null,lapse:false,recoverySecured:false,deliveries:0,earnings:0};
  return data.days[k];
}
function ensureMonth(k=currentMonthKey()){if(!Array.isArray(data.payments[k]))data.payments[k]=[];return data.payments[k]}
function nextMonthKey(k){const [y,m]=String(k).split('-').map(Number);return monthKey(new Date(y,m,1))}
function paymentSeriesKey(p){return p?.seriesId||`name:${paymentNameKey(p?.name)}`}
function syncRecurringPaymentsThrough(targetKey=currentMonthKey()){
  const keys=Object.keys(data.payments||{}).filter(k=>/^\d{4}-\d{2}$/.test(k)).sort();
  if(!keys.length)return 0;
  let cursor=keys[0],added=0,guard=0;
  while(cursor<targetKey&&guard++<240){
    const next=nextMonthKey(cursor),src=data.payments[cursor]||[],dest=ensureMonth(next);
    const existing=new Set(dest.map(paymentSeriesKey));
    for(const p of src){
      if(p.recurrence!=='monthly')continue;
      const seriesId=p.seriesId||p.id||uid();
      p.seriesId=seriesId;
      if(data.paymentSeriesDisabled?.[seriesId])continue;
      const sk=paymentSeriesKey(p);
      if(existing.has(sk))continue;
      const dueDate=p.dueDay?dueDateStringForMonth(next,p.dueDay):null;
      dest.push({
        ...normalizePayment(p,dest.length,next),
        id:uid(),seriesId,recurrence:'monthly',dueDate,paid:false,paidAt:null
      });
      existing.add(sk);added++;
    }
    cursor=next;
  }
  return added;
}
function protectedAmount(){const s=data.settings;return Number(s.gambleLoss)+Number(s.uberOpportunityLoss)+Number(s.afterImpactDays)*Number(s.afterImpactPerDay)}

function hashSeed(text){
  let h=2166136261;
  for(const ch of String(text)){h^=ch.charCodeAt(0);h=Math.imul(h,16777619)}
  return h>>>0;
}
function pickDaily(list,salt=''){
  if(!list.length)return null;
  return list[hashSeed(`${appDayKey()}|${salt}`)%list.length];
}
function lossOpportunityGroups(amount){
  amount=Math.max(0,Number(amount)||0);
  const uberDay=Math.max(1,Number(data.settings.uberOpportunityLoss)||13000);
  const savingsGoal=Math.max(10000,Number(data.settings.savingsGoal)||100000);
  const fmt1=n=>Number(n).toLocaleString('ja-JP',{maximumFractionDigits:1});
  const floor=n=>Math.max(1,Math.floor(n));
  return [
    [
      {icon:'🏦',title:'貯金目標',value:`${fmt1(amount/savingsGoal*100)}%分`,note:`${money(savingsGoal)}目標に対して`},
      {icon:'🧾',title:'1万円の支払い',value:`${floor(amount/10000)}件分`,note:'支払いを前へ進める原資'},
      {icon:'🛟',title:'緊急予備費',value:`約${fmt1(amount/30000)}口分`,note:'3万円を1口として換算'},
      {icon:'📅',title:'週1万円貯金',value:`約${fmt1(amount/10000)}週分`,note:'毎週1万円積み立てるなら'},
      {icon:'💳',title:'2万円の返済',value:`${floor(amount/20000)}回分`,note:'2万円ずつ返す場合'}
    ],
    [
      {icon:'🛵',title:'Uber売上',value:`約${fmt1(amount/uberDay)}日分`,note:`1日${money(uberDay)}換算`},
      {icon:'🧠',title:'RYVI制作予算',value:money(amount),note:'ツール・素材・公開費用へ回せる'},
      {icon:'💻',title:'仕事環境の改善',value:money(amount),note:'PC周辺機器・ストレージ等の予算'},
      {icon:'🧰',title:'5千円の制作費',value:`${floor(amount/5000)}回分`,note:'小さな改善を積み上げるなら'},
      {icon:'🧩',title:'月3千円サービス',value:`約${floor(amount/3000)}か月分`,note:'制作系サブスク等の換算例'}
    ],
    [
      {icon:'🍚',title:'生活費',value:`約${floor(amount/2000)}日分`,note:'1日2,000円で換算'},
      {icon:'🍱',title:'3千円の食事',value:`${floor(amount/3000)}回分`,note:'外食・楽しみに置き換えるなら'},
      {icon:'🎯',title:'5千円の自由枠',value:`${floor(amount/5000)}回分`,note:'好きなことに使える選択肢'},
      {icon:'🥪',title:'1,500円の食事',value:`${floor(amount/1500)}回分`,note:'日常の具体的な価値に戻す'},
      {icon:'🚃',title:'1千円の移動費',value:`${floor(amount/1000)}日分`,note:'1日1,000円で換算'}
    ]
  ];
}
function dailyLossOpportunities(amount){
  return lossOpportunityGroups(amount).map((group,i)=>pickDaily(group,`loss-${i}-${Math.round(Number(amount)||0)}`)).filter(Boolean);
}
function opportunityCardsMarkup(amount){
  return dailyLossOpportunities(amount).map(x=>`<div class="value-alt"><span class="icon">${x.icon}</span><b>${x.title}</b><strong>${x.value}</strong><small>${x.note}</small></div>`).join('');
}
function renderValueAlternatives(amount,todayRec=ensureToday()){
  const box=document.getElementById('valueAlternatives');if(!box)return;
  document.getElementById('valueAlternativesAmount').textContent=money(amount);
  document.getElementById('valueAlternativesList').innerHTML=opportunityCardsMarkup(amount);
  const head=box.querySelector('.value-alternatives-head span');
  if(head)head.textContent=todayRec?.lapse?'ここで追加損失を止めれば':'この損失を防げば';
}
function getCleanDays(){return Object.values(data.days).filter(d=>d.clean&&!d.lapse).length}
function getCurrentStreak(){
  let cur=appDate(),streak=0;
  for(let i=0;i<5000;i++){
    const rec=data.days[ymd(cur)];
    if(i===0&&rec?.lapse)return 0;
    if(rec?.clean&&!rec?.lapse)streak++;
    else if(i===0){/* today may still be in progress */}
    else break;
    cur.setDate(cur.getDate()-1);
  }
  return streak;
}
function getChallengeDay(){return Math.max(1,daysBetween(parseDate(data.createdAt),appDate())+1)}
function savingsLevels(){const goal=Math.max(10000,Number(data.settings.savingsGoal)||100000),base=[10000,30000,50000,100000,300000,500000,1000000].filter(v=>v<goal);return [...new Set([...base,goal])].sort((a,b)=>a-b)}
function currentMilestone(){const s=Number(data.savings)||0;return savingsLevels().find(v=>s<v)||null}
function todayLapses(){const t=appDayKey();return data.lapses.filter(l=>l.date===t)}
function todayActualGambleLoss(){return todayLapses().reduce((a,l)=>a+(Number(l.loss)||0),0)}


function previousMonthKey(k=currentMonthKey()){
  const [y,m]=String(k).split('-').map(Number),d=new Date(y,m-2,1);
  return monthKey(d);
}
function paymentNameKey(name){return String(name||'').trim().toLocaleLowerCase('ja-JP')}
function paymentPaidDate(p){
  if(!p?.paidAt)return null;
  const d=new Date(p.paidAt);
  return Number.isNaN(d.getTime())?null:d;
}
function paymentDueDateForMonth(p,k){
  if(/^\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}$/.test(String(p?.dueDate||''))){
    const d=parseDate(p.dueDate);if(Number.isNaN(d.getTime()))return null;
    d.setHours(23,59,59,999);return d;
  }
  if(p?.recurrence==='monthly'&&p?.dueDay){
    const exact=dueDateStringForMonth(k,p.dueDay);if(!exact)return null;
    const d=parseDate(exact);d.setHours(23,59,59,999);return d;
  }
  return null;
}
function paymentLeadDays(p,k){
  const paid=paymentPaidDate(p),due=paymentDueDateForMonth(p,k);
  if(!paid||!due)return null;
  const paidDay=new Date(paid.getFullYear(),paid.getMonth(),paid.getDate());
  const dueDay=new Date(due.getFullYear(),due.getMonth(),due.getDate());
  return Math.round((dueDay-paidDay)/86400000);
}
function allPaymentRows(){
  const rows=[];
  for(const k of Object.keys(data.payments||{}).sort())(data.payments[k]||[]).forEach((p,i)=>rows.push({p,i,k,due:paymentDueDateForMonth(p,k)}));
  return rows;
}
function findSeriesIdByName(name){
  const nk=paymentNameKey(name);
  for(const {p} of allPaymentRows())if(p.recurrence==='monthly'&&paymentNameKey(p.name)===nk&&p.seriesId)return p.seriesId;
  return null;
}
function activeMonthlySeriesCount(){
  const set=new Set();
  for(const {p} of allPaymentRows()){
    if(p.recurrence!=='monthly')continue;
    const sid=p.seriesId||`name:${paymentNameKey(p.name)}`;
    if(!data.paymentSeriesDisabled?.[sid])set.add(sid);
  }
  return set.size;
}
function findPreviousRecurring(p,k){
  if(p?.recurrence!=='monthly')return null;
  const currentDue=paymentDueDateForMonth(p,k);if(!currentDue)return null;
  const candidates=[];
  for(const row of allPaymentRows()){
    const x=row.p;if(x.id===p.id||x.recurrence!=='monthly')continue;
    const sameSeries=p.seriesId?x.seriesId===p.seriesId:paymentNameKey(x.name)===paymentNameKey(p.name);
    if(!sameSeries||!row.due||row.due>=currentDue)continue;
    candidates.push(row);
  }
  candidates.sort((a,b)=>b.due-a.due);
  if(!candidates.length)return null;
  const hit=candidates[0];return {prevKey:hit.k,prev:hit.p,prevDue:hit.due,currentDue};
}
function paymentComparison(p,k=currentMonthKey()){
  if(p?.recurrence!=='monthly')return null;
  const hit=findPreviousRecurring(p,k),prev=hit?.prev,prevKey=hit?.prevKey;
  const prevLead=paymentLeadDays(prev,prevKey);
  if(!prev||prevLead===null)return null;
  const consecutive=monthKey(hit.prevDue)===previousMonthKey(monthKey(hit.currentDue));
  const baseLabel=consecutive?'先月':'前回';
  const prevText=prevLead>0?`${baseLabel}：期限${prevLead}日前`:prevLead===0?`${baseLabel}：期限日に支払い`:`${baseLabel}：${Math.abs(prevLead)}日遅れ`;
  if(!p.paid||!paymentPaidDate(p))return {state:'pending',text:prevText};
  const curLead=paymentLeadDays(p,k);if(curLead===null)return null;
  const delta=curLead-prevLead;
  if(delta>0)return {state:'better',delta,text:`${baseLabel}より${delta}日早く支払えた`};
  if(delta===0)return {state:'same',delta:0,text:`${baseLabel}と同じペースで支払い`};
  return {state:'later',delta,text:`${baseLabel}より${Math.abs(delta)}日遅いペース`};
}
function paymentStats(){
  let paidOnTime=0,totalPaid=0;
  const keys=Object.keys(data.payments||{}).sort();
  const allImprovements=[];
  for(const k of keys){
    for(const p of data.payments[k]||[]){
      if(p.paid){
        const paid=paymentPaidDate(p);if(paid){totalPaid++;const due=paymentDueDateForMonth(p,k);if(due&&paid<=due)paidOnTime++}
      }
      const cmp=paymentComparison(p,k);if(cmp?.state==='better')allImprovements.push({...cmp,month:k,name:p.name});
    }
  }
  const currentImprovements=(ensureMonth(currentMonthKey())||[]).map(p=>paymentComparison(p,currentMonthKey())).filter(x=>x?.state==='better');
  return {paidOnTime,totalPaid,allImprovements,currentImprovements};
}
const GROWTH_STAGES=[
  {min:0,stage:'RESTART',titles:['再起動前','どん底再始動','立ち上がる者'],character:'data:image/webp;base64,'},
  {min:80,stage:'SPARK',titles:['火種','最初の一歩','小さく始める者'],character:'data:image/webp;base64,
